hints.highlight: Shown large — a discount, a price or a short word.
hints.barNoImage: The sticky bar does not show an image.
hints.couponCode: Visitors get a one-tap Copy button. Leave empty to hide.
hints.countdownNeedsEnd: Set "Offer ends at" to show the countdown.
hints.pickForm: Pick a form, or the button does nothing.
hints.exit: Opens when the mouse heads for the browser tabs. On phones (no mouse) it opens after 20 seconds instead.
hints.frequency: Counted per visitor, on their browser. Clicking the button counts as done — they are not asked again.
hints.startAfterEnd: The start is after the end — the popup will never show.
hints.ended: This offer has ended — visitors no longer see the popup.
hints.colours: Leave empty to use the site’s brand colour.
hints.customHtml: Paste HTML with its <style> in the same box — the popup splits them. Scripts, forms and iframes are removed. Site colours: hsl(var(--primary-500)). The ✕ close button is always added.
hints.customTooLong: Too long — anything past the limit is cut off on the site.
hints.endDate: The countdown runs to this time, and the popup stops showing after it.
hints.startDate: Leave empty to start right away.
hints.endDateCustom: Used by data-vacademy="countdown" in your HTML, and the popup stops showing after it.
